subject.title: fix: preserve selected GitHub skills across resync

question: Should ClawHub accept selectedSkillPaths as the persisted GitHub source contract, including legacy all-skills behavior for existing sources without a saved selection?
rationale: This changes upgrade behavior and operator semantics for existing GitHub-backed sources, and the evidence does not prove maintainer intent for that compatibility contract.

options.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Sources
options.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, drop the merged warm-up overlap, fix dry-run selected-path counts, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

options.title: Accept Contract As-Is
options.body: Maintainers can intentionally accept the stored selection contract while separately tracking the dry-run inconsistency and runtime proof gap.

options.title: Pause Selection Policy
options.body: Keep the draft paused if maintainers are not ready to make selected skill paths part of GitHub source configuration.

recommendation.title: Refresh And Prove Selected Sources
recommendation.body: Resolve the dirty merge state, drop the merged warm-up overlap, fix dry-run selected-path counts, and validate selected plus legacy source sync before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen introduced and most recently maintained the GitHub-backed skill source contract that this PR extends.
